# Known vulnerabilities in the pinned runtime dependencies.
#
# CI runs pip-audit against requirements.txt and ignores exactly these IDs, so
# the build goes red the day a NEW advisory
# lands on anything we ship. A line here is debt, not a waiver: add one only
# with a note on why it cannot be fixed yet, and delete it when it can.
#
# Format: one ID per line; everything after '#' is a note.
#
# Empty since the 2026-09-26 upgrade (FastAPI/Starlette/python-multipart,
# python-jose -> PyJWT, gunicorn, sentry-sdk; unused fastapi-mail and
# google-generativeai dropped). Keep it that way: fix, don't list.
